name: Maximized Channel (Meta-Channeling)
body:
You have learned to pack the maximum power into your channeling efforts, though it expends your energy faster.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy class feature.

Benefit(s): When you use your channel ability energy, you can choose for all variable, numeric effects to be maximized. Saving throws and opposed rolls are not affected. Maximized Channeling requires the channeler to utilize two additional channeling uses in order to achieve this effect. Heart of Faith You need no outward symbol to manifest your faith through.

Prerequisite(s): Divine Spellcaster

Benefit(s): You have no need for a divine focus or holy symbol, either for casting divine spells or for channeling energy.
